items.explanation: Senior update: rekomendasi jelas, alasan risiko, mitigasi, alternatif ringan, dan ownership komunikasi. Frasa: "recommend a one-week slip" = usulkan tunda; "risk outweighs…" = risiko lebih besar; "I will own…" = tanggung jawab. A abai risiko; C overreact; D mendorong keputusan tanpa input.

validate runbooks
keep a soft launch path if legal needs a milestone. I will own the partner comms draft
